iprem_2026_monthly.note: Indicador Público de Renta de Efectos Múltiples. Frozen at €600/month (€7,200/year in 12 payments) since 2021 because no new Presupuestos Generales del Estado (PGE) have been approved for 2024, 2025, or 2026 — the 2023 budget keeps being extended. This is the reference value for NLV, family reunification, and student subsistence thresholds. A new PGE would move this figure and every threshold that depends on it simultaneously — the single highest-impact live risk in this dataset.

smi_2026_monthly.note: Salario Mínimo Interprofesional. Set by Real Decreto 126/2026, approved 17 February 2026, published in the BOE 18 February 2026, retroactive to 1 January 2026. Paid in 14 payments/year, so annual = €1,221 × 14 = €17,094. This is the reference value for the Digital Nomad Visa threshold.
